standards_review.notes: all 14 commit subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format

guide prefers parameterized generics over bare dict; bare dict at hook.py:161, compressor.py:27 and :39, sdk_compressor.py:109, sidecar_compressor.py:37. Headers, __future__ annotations, cohesion conform.
no credential logging; strict JSON parsing. docker-compose headroom service defaults HEADROOM_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND to 1 and empty HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN on 0.0.0.0; sidecar traffic is plain http.

finding_status.notes: docker-compose.yml: HEADROOM_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_BIND now defaults to 0 with explicit dev opt-in; HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN wired into the codemie service env.
hook.py: _Observation.mode set from new get_compressor_mode() (sidecar|sdk) before any compressor is built; none/unknown removed; tests updated and parametrized.
compressor.py, hook.py _merge, sdk_compressor.py and sidecar_compressor.py now use dict[str, Any] / list[dict[str, Any]]; grep finds no remaining bare dict annotations.
sdk_compressor.py _load_sdk catches Exception, sets _unavailable and raises HeadroomCompressionError; test asserts a single attempt and one error log for OSError.

Added importorskip('headroom') tests for override installed and read via _get_pipeline (exists in pinned 0.40.0), CompressConfig kwargs for all strategies, no retrieve marker; plus hasattr guard so a missing _pipeline falls back with a warning. Not executed here.
